_comment: The tools/list of the Snowflake Labs MCP server (snowflake-labs-mcp) with the object and query managers on, as its documentation describes it, written offline (UNVERIFIED: not read from a running server). The live check, when one is run, compares the real tools/list with this pin.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List Snowflake objects of a type, optionally within a database and schema.

object_type.description: The type of object, such as database, schema, table or view

like.description: A LIKE pattern on the name

object_name.description: The fully qualified name of the object

tools.name: run_snowflake_query
tools.description: Run a SQL statement in Snowflake. Only the statement types the service configuration permits run.

tools.name: create_or_alter_object
tools.description: Create or alter a Snowflake object.
